_readme: Freeze this file before the baseline run. Append a v2 file later; never edit v1 in place.
stage: discover | decide | specify | compose | validate | meta
shape: adopter (hand-written from real questions) | agent (harvested from real task runs)
source: support | search-log | pr-comment | github-issue | harvested | manual
answerable: false means no tool on the server can answer it. That count is a metric on its own.
answer_contains: substrings that prove a correct answer. Keep them specific and stable.
Target roughly 60 adopter and 40 agent intents to reach 100.

intents.text: What should I use to let someone pick a date range for a bill cycle?
intents.notes: Three plausible entry points. Watch the confusion matrix on this one.

intents.text: Is there a dropdown component in VDS?
intents.notes: Vocabulary test: adopters say dropdown, the library may not.

intents.text: Should I use a Modal or a Drawer for a long form?
intents.notes: Cross-component decision. No per-component tool can answer it properly.

intents.text: Can I use a secondary button inside a card footer?
intents.notes: No automatic ground truth. Scored on tool selection; flag for manual review.

intents.text: What props does Button take and what are the valid variants?
intents.notes: Six tools could plausibly answer this. Prime overlap candidate.

intents.text: Does Button need to be wrapped in a provider?
intents.notes: Setup knowledge split across component and setup tools.

intents.text: What are the accessibility requirements for the Table component?
intents.notes: Expect near-zero call count for this tool. That is the finding.

intents.text: What is the right token for a card background on a dark surface?
I have #D52B1E hardcoded. Which token should that be?
intents.notes: Reverse token lookup. No tool supports this direction today.

intents.text: Build me a plan comparison section with three tiers and a sticky CTA.
intents.notes: No composition or template tool exists. Watch browse_all_pages absorb this.

intents.text: Is this JSX using VDS correctly?
intents.notes: No validation tool. Every intent like this is a tag C.

intents.text: How do I migrate a screen from the old Monarch library?
How do I install and set up VDS in a new React app?
intents.notes: Constant content. Belongs in AGENTS.md rather than a tool.

intents.text: Who do I contact if a component is broken?
intents.notes: Two tools, one question. Direct overlap test.

intents.text: Button props
intents.notes: Agents ask in fragments after they have already guessed a name.
